subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain builtin `memory status` report `Vector store: ready` from persisted `vectorDims` metadata while `--deep` remains the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is code-correct, but it changes user-visible CLI and JSON status semantics for existing indexed databases, so automation should not decide the status contract on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Meaning
options.body: Revise the wording or add a separate indexed-vector signal if `Vector store: ready` must mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For Another Contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want a different canonical fix for the linked memory-status issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers agree that plain status should report prior successful vector indexing from metadata and reserve live sqlite-vec loadability for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is assigned on the live PR and has recent memory storage/reindex history in the affected area.
